findings.problem: RULE-CAT-048 includes ENT-CAT-006 Category, a SHARED entity, in its scope and says every deactivation publishes a catalogue-change event with kind DEACTIVATED. REQ-CAT-008, RULE-CAT-049, CON-CAT-018 and the PHASE CORE event list cover only ENT-CAT-001, 002, 005, 007, 008, 009 and 010. API-CAT-021, 023, 024 and 053 do not honour CON-CAT-018 and record no event. SFR (browse) and INS (reporting) read Category and get no signal when a Category is deactivated, moved or reactivated.
findings.fix: Recommended: add ENT-CAT-006 to REQ-CAT-008, RULE-CAT-049, CON-CAT-018 (the entity list of the signature) and the PHASE CORE event list. Record CREATED, UPDATED, DEACTIVATED and REACTIVATED events in API-CAT-021, 023, 024 and 053, mark them `Honours: CON-CAT-018`, and add RULE-CAT-049 / CAT-500-CHANGE-NOT-SAVED to their Errors and to the api-spec. Add an AC and a TC asserting one DEACTIVATED event on Category deactivation. The alternative, which stays non-breaking for the contract, is to remove ENT-CAT-006 from RULE-CAT-048's event clause.

findings.problem: CAT_NORMALIZE_AR (BLOCK 1) removes characters with the class `[ً-ٰٟـ]`. That class is the range U+064B–U+0670 plus U+065F and U+0640, so it also deletes the Arabic-Indic digits U+0660–U+0669 and the marks U+066A–U+066F. ADR-CAT-062 and RULE-CAT-003 name only U+064B–U+065F, U+0670 and U+0640. As a result, «علبة ٢٥» and «علبة ٣٠» both normalise to «علبة». UQ_CAT_ITEM_NAME_AR then refuses the second Item with RULE-CAT-003, and the trigram search returns wrong rows. The Java mirror that ADR-CAT-062 requires would also disagree with the DB index.
findings.fix: Write the class with explicit code points: `regexp_replace(P_TEXT, '[\u064B-\u065F\u0670\u0640]', '', 'g')`, using an E'' string or chr() ranges. Have the Java normaliser use the same set. Add TCs: «علبة ٢٥» and «علبة ٣٠» must both be created, and «أحمر» vs «احمر» must still collide (CAT-409-ITEM-NAME-DUPLICATE).

findings.problem: API-CAT-049 rejects an import row whose GTIN begins with an active scale-label prefix (RULE-CAT-032). RULE-CAT-045, the SRS source of the import row checks, does not list RULE-CAT-032, and no AC or TC covers that row.
findings.fix: Add RULE-CAT-032 to RULE-CAT-045's statement and to RULE-CAT-032's trigger ('on import row'). Add an AC: an import row with GTIN 2000000000008, while an active layout with prefix 20 exists, is rejected on column GTIN barcode with the RULE-CAT-032 message as {reason}. Add the matching TC on API-CAT-049.

findings.problem: The plan marks `variantPk` and `copies` of each LabelRequest line (API-CAT-050) as required, but the `lines.items` schema in api-spec-cat.yaml has no `required` array. The mock server would accept a line without them, and the document disagrees with the plan.
findings.fix: Add `required: [variantPk, copies]` to `LabelRequest.lines.items`, and regenerate api-spec-cat.yaml from the plan.
